To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the combination of the biological motion analysis and a fusion strategy based the belief theory is able to perform an efficient reduction of a fluent cued speech coding to a discrete chain of static hand gestures.
the combination of the belief theory with a biological motion analysis method allows to perform an accurate extraction of the static hand gestures in dynamic context.
the fusion of biological motion analysis and belief theory enables to extract static hand gestures in dynamic contexts, with a very high accuracy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new method to recognize cued speech.
the extraction of the static gestures from cued speech in dynamic context.
the development and evaluation of a new method to extract the static hand gestures in dynamic context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cued speech is an automatic process, and the results obtained in this paper are in accordance with this statement.
the fusion strategy based on belief theory is an efficient and robust approach for extracting the cued speech static hand gestures.
the proposed approach is efficient in the sense that it is able to reduce cued speech to its static hand gestures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the fusion of two complementary cues, namely the motion information and the shape one, is a good way to reduce the cued speech stream.

a static gesture can be defined as a combination of two types of features: the first one is a set of static features that are extracted from the gesture itself (e.g., the hand shape, its orientation), and the second one is a set that describes the context of the gesture in the dynamic stream (e.g., a gesture that is presented in the middle of a sentence is different from a gesture that is at the end of a sentence).
the fusion strategy allows to improve the recognition performance of a given motion analysis method by taking into account the information provided by the other motion analysis method.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of a motion analysis method based on a biological motion analysis and a belief theory-based fusion strategy allows for an accurate extraction of the discrete gestures in dynamic context.
the fusion of several cues, each of them providing complementary information, allows the extraction of the cued speech static gesture from a continuous cuing coding stream.
the combination of the biological motion analysis and a fusion strategy is a good way to deal with this problem.
